name: io.github.afmontoya/baconservices-mcp
title: Bacon Services
description: Pay-per-call image tools for agents: remove backgrounds, optimize for web. USDC on Base via x402.

environmentVariables.name: BACON_WALLET_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file holding the buyer wallet's private key (USDC on Base). Or set BACON_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: BACON_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The buyer wallet's private key, if not using a key file. Use a dedicated wallet.

environmentVariables.name: BACON_MAX_PER_SESSION
environmentVariables.description: Most this process may spend, in USDC.

environmentVariables.name: BACON_MAX_PER_DAY
environmentVariables.description: Most spent in any rolling 24 hours, persisted across restarts, in USDC.

environmentVariables.name: BACON_CONFIRM
environmentVariables.description: auto, always or never: ask before each payment when the host can.
